title: Challenges and Solutions for Bandits in the Wild: Warm-Started Mixture Bandits for Cross-Cohort Slate Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2609.37800v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many recommender services repeatedly encounter cold-start cohorts, where new users arrive with little or no interaction history. This creates two challenges: learning user preferences quickly from limited feedback and sustaining useful recommendations when each user has a finite catalog that can become repetitive or depleted over time. We propose CohortMix-TS, a warm-started mixture bandit that learns latent user groups from earlier cohorts and uses available metadata to construct group-informed priors for new users. Starting from these fixed priors, the model personalizes independently as feedback from each user becomes available. Session slates combine Thompson sampling with diversity and inventory-depletion controls. We evaluate CohortMix-TS through simulation, semi-synthetic experiments, and a 25-day randomized in-the-wild deployment with 713 registered participants in a Campus Games quiz application. translated_title: 真实环境中老虎机算法的挑战与解决方案：面向跨群体列表推荐的预热启动混合老虎机
translated_abstract: 许多推荐服务会反复遇到冷启动群体问题，即新用户到来时几乎没有或完全没有交互历史。这带来了两个挑战：一是如何从有限的反馈中快速学习用户偏好，二是当每个用户的可用目录有限、随时间推移可能变得重复或耗尽时，如何持续提供有用的推荐。我们提出了CohortMix-TS，一种预热启动的混合老虎机算法，它从早期用户群体中学习潜在用户群组，并利用可用的元数据为新用户构建基于群组信息的先验。从这些固定的先验出发，模型随着每个用户反馈的到来而独立地进行个性化。会话列表将汤普森采样与多样性和库存耗尽控制相结合。我们通过仿真、半合成实验以及在一个Campus Games问答应用中为期25天、共有713名注册参与者参加的真实环境随机部署来评估CohortMix-TS。我们的评估表明，跨（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出CohortMix-TS，一种预热启动的混合老虎机算法，通过从早期用户群体学习潜在群组并构建群组先验来解决冷启动推荐问题，同时结合多样性与库存耗尽控制生成会话列表，并在为期25天、713名参与者的真实随机部署中验证了其有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CohortMix-TS, a warm-started mixture bandit that learns latent user groups from earlier cohorts to construct group-informed priors for cold-start users, combining Thompson sampling with diversity and inventory-depletion controls for slate recommendation, and validates it in a 25-day randomized in-the-wild deployment with 713 participants.
